tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Explore Results
tool.description: open the integrated scientific dashboard, plots, tables, CIFs, and GPX checkpoints
tool.command: #import re touch '$session_log' && chmod a+r '$session_log' && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p site/{plots,tables,phases,gpx,diagnostics} && cp '$report' site/index.html && cp '$summary' site/summary.json && #if str($plots) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $plots #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/plots/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($tables) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $tables #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/tables/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($phases) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $phases #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/phases/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($gpx_projects) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $gpx_projects #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/gpx/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($diagnostics) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $diagnostics #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/diagnostics/$name' && #end for #end if printf '%s\n' 'RADAR-PD interactive result explorer started on port 8080.' > '$session_log' && python -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory site
tool.help: Open this after a RADAR-PD analysis to inspect the integrated scientific dashboard. It presents final hypotheses or phases, fit quality, phase fractions, stage timing, warnings, plots, result tables, CIF files, and GSAS-II checkpoints without making you open each History dataset separately. Galaxy remains the system of record. To continue a refinement, send a selected GPX checkpoint through **RADAR-PD Utility: GSAS-II Project Handoff** and open it in the hosted GSAS-II tool.
